project_type: Next.js 14 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS finance/news site for a US audience
build_system: npm (Next.js). Node is NOT on PATH by default in the sandbox - source nvm first: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh". Node v22.23.2, next 14.2.35.
test_framework: None. No test suite exists. Verification is via next build + next lint only.
verification_instructions: Source nvm, then run `npm run lint` (must report 'No ESLint warnings or errors') AND `npm run build` (must complete with no type/build errors). Both currently PASS on baseline commit 71d2f0f and must stay passing. There is no test runner and no Dockerfile.
snapshot_or_generated_files: next build runs a postbuild `next-sitemap` step generating sitemap files in public/ and .next/. These are build artifacts, not checked in as source. No snapshot tests.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed in node_modules. If missing: source nvm then `npm install`. No .env needed for build (Sanity falls back to sample data in data/sample-news.ts).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Docker. No test framework. Node must be sourced via nvm before any npm command. Do NOT push or open a PR - leave commits on local main with clean tree.
contribution_requirements: Work in a few coherent commits on local `main`. Do NOT push, do NOT open a PR. Keep `npm run build` and `npm run lint` green.
key_patterns: DESIGN SYSTEM: 'Ink & Oxblood' base palette + single electric-blue `accent` (tailwind.config.ts). borderRadius scale is clamped to 2px for all named sizes (rounded-xl/2xl == 2px) - the 'modern' feel comes from gradient icon badges, hover lift, accent glow and CTAs, NOT from large corner radii. rounded-full still works (9999px) for avatars/dots. MODERN-CARD PATTERN (established on app/(site)/page.tsx, replicate it): `group relative flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-hairline bg-surface p-6 transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-accent/40 dark:border-hairline-dark dark:bg-elevated dark:hover:border-accent-light/40` with (a) a soft accent glow span `pointer-events-none absolute -right-8 -top-8 h-24 w-24 rounded-full bg-accent/0 blur-2xl transition-colors duration-300 group-hover:bg-accent/10`, (b) a gradient icon badge `inline-flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-accent-gradient text-white shadow-sm` wrapping a <LineIcon>, (c) `.title-link` headings, (d) a bottom CTA row `inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-eyebrow font-semibold uppercase text-accent transition-transform duration-150 group-hover:gap-2 dark:text-accent-light` with a nudging arrow. Wrap grids in <Reveal delay={i*0.05}>. Section headers: <Reveal className="section-header"> + .eyebrow + .section-title. REUSE globals.css utilities (.container-page, .container-prose, .section-padding, .page-title, .section-header, .section-title, .eyebrow, .eyebrow-accent, .panel, .field-input, .field-label, .field-error, .data-table, .link-accent, .btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .title-link) and components (Reveal, AnimatedCounter, Sparkline, LineIcon, ArticleCard, CategoryBadge) rather than inventing one-off styles. Accent focus rings: `focus:border-accent focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent dark:focus:border-accent-light`. Use `bg-surface`/`bg-elevated` NOT raw `bg-white`.
relevant_files: app/globals.css (utilities - reuse; only add a utility if truly shared)
components/icons/LineIcon.tsx (names: house, trend-up, card, bars, coins, target, umbrella, globe, bank)
app/(site)/calculators/*/page.tsx (7 calculators - only touch results/educational JSX styling if needed; DO NOT change math or JSON-LD)
directory_structure: app/(site)/ = public pages inside a route group wrapped by Header/Footer (app/(site)/layout.tsx). app/studio/ = Sanity Studio - DO NOT TOUCH. components/ organized by feature (home/, news/, banks/, calculators/, motion/, icons/). lib/ = sanity-queries.ts, category-styles.ts (getCategoryTone), schema-markup.ts (JSON-LD helpers), sanity.ts. data/ = sample-news.ts + banks.ts (DO NOT modify). config/site.ts = siteConfig (name, url, tagline, description). Do NOT change: calculator math, CryptoTicker/MarketHero/MarketDataWidget, /api/market, lib/sanity-queries.ts, data/*, the Studio, or any SEO metadata/Open Graph/Article JSON-LD.
constraints: Keep Ink & Oxblood base; electric-blue accent is the single vibrant accent (gradient badges, hover borders, CTAs, focus rings). Do NOT reintroduce teal/amber tokens. Fully responsive (mobile-first). Reduced-motion safe: Reveal handles it; any new CSS transitions that animate transforms must include motion-reduce: guards (e.g., motion-reduce:transform-none). Preserve ALL SEO: page metadata, Open Graph, Article JSON-LD on article pages, HowTo JSON-LD on calculators, FinancialService/BreadcrumbList/CollectionPage JSON-LD on bank pages. Keep all calculator math/logic and every calculator's inputs/results semantics unchanged.
